## For Philosophers
I am always open to coauthoring, organizing workshops, and sharing works-in-progress on topics such as uncertainty, epistemic values, and model evaluation.  

[Learn more →](for-philosophers.qmd)

## For Scientists
My talks and collaborations focus on clarifying uncertainty, model evaluation, and decision support in plain language. I regularly give seminars and colloquia in science departments.  

[Learn more →](for-scientists.qmd)

## Collaboration Ideas
- Communicating uncertainty responsibly  
- Diagnosing error in climate model ensembles  
- Robust inference under deep uncertainty  
- Modeling for decision support in climate adaptation  
- Communicating deep uncertainty to public stakeholders  
- Philosophy of machine learning in climate science  
- Philosophy of geoengineering and climate intervention ethics
